The '''Glacial Paths''' was a region of the [[Highmount Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that was characterized by the deep rifts and canyons in the surface of the icy ground.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Glacial Paths appears as part of the Highmount Ridge on Hoth in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
